assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-197.
The claim was billed with diagnosis codes G45.9, I25.10, and I49.5.
There is a clinical indication note documenting the patient's condition.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope.
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease.
The patient had a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack.
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of cerebral hypoperfusion.
The telemetry is also ordered to optimize rate control.
The denial was a precertification (prior authorization) denial.
